verdict.rationale: LlamaParse offers webhook endpoints so external systems get notified when parsing jobs complete, fail, or change state, which is a basic event-trigger mechanism (llamaparse-docs-6). However, there's no evidence of a rule-definition system (conditional logic, multiple trigger types, or built-in automated actions) beyond simple job-status notifications. missing for 10: a rules engine for defining conditions and automated actions, support for triggers beyond job completion/failure, and any documented action types beyond notifying an endpoint.
